symptom: ako/mxcli#1794: for a project with stale stored widget definitions, docker check failed (CE0463) while docker build / run / reload succeeded, building a widget-normalised copy; run --local and Studio Pro failed on the same project.
cause: buildOnCopy ran mx update-widgets on its temporary copy before the pre-build mx check and MxBuild — the pre-#646 docker check behaviour, never revisited for the build.
file: cmd/mxcli/docker/build.go (buildOnCopy checks the stored copy, recheckCE0463 labels, UpdateWidgetsFirst opt-in), cmd/mxcli/docker.go (--update-widgets on build/run/reload)
insight: When one gate's default changes (#646: check what is stored), every other command that runs the same tool on a copy needs the same decision, or two gates disagree about one project and the green one is believed.
